args.message:
These are the revenue totals for the three calendar months ending in each month from September to December 2024. Revenue is the sum of all order amounts, with no filter on order status.

There are no orders at all in August 2024, so I counted August as zero. That makes the September and October totals lower than the others.

- **September 2024:** July 10,177.42 + August 0 + September 9,259.91 = 19,437.33
- **October 2024:** August 0 + September 9,259.91 + October 8,958.22 = 18,218.13
- **November 2024:** September 9,259.91 + October 8,958.22 + November 9,247.11 = 27,465.24
- **December 2024:** October 8,958.22 + November 9,247.11 + December 10,371.18 = 28,576.51
